question: what club sports are there? looking for something competitive but not d3 varsity level
answer:
Ramapo’s admitted-student page lists competitive sports clubs for everyone, regardless of ability level: cheer, dance, ice hockey, rock climbing, tennis, wrestling, esports, and mixed martial arts. For more information, it links to [Intramural & Club Sports Info](https://ramapoathletics.com/sports/2018/9/26/intramurals-and-competitive-sports-clubs.aspx). [2]

Specific options described on the club pages:
- Ramapo College Indoor Soccer Club (Athletics): competitive co-ed indoor soccer; 7 vs 7 fall and winter league at Superdome Sports, plus open practices in the Aux Gym. Email rcisc@ramapo.edu. [4][15]
- Ramapo College Disc Club (Athletics): Ultimate team competes in tournaments at Ramapo and along the east coast. Email rchammerultimate@ramapo.edu to join. [5][8][13]
- Ramapo Lacrosse Club (Athletics): National College Lacrosse League team for men enrolled at Ramapo. Email laxclub@ramapo.edu. [6][7][12]
- Rock Climbing Club (Athletics): prepares members for CCS (College Climbing Series) competitions. Email rockclimbing@ramapo.edu. [9][16]

The directory also lists Sports Club (Student Organization), a broader group for playing and watching sports: https://archway.ramapo.edu/Sport/. [1][3] Ski & Snowboard Club organizes events and trips, but its page doesn’t describe competition. Email skiclub@ramapo.edu. [10]

For club information, contact the Center for Student Involvement: csi@ramapo.edu, (201) 684-7593, SC-202. [3]
